title: 348. Different Ways to Add Parentheses

examples.explanation: Parenthesizing as 2*(3-(4*5)) gives -34, and the other groupings give -14, -10, -10, and 10.

hints: Treat every operator as a possible last evaluation step and recurse on both sides.
Combine each left value with each right value through the current operator.
Memoize results per substring to avoid recomputation.
